name: mattermost
title: Mattermost
description: Mattermost Team Edition: a self-hosted Slack — channels, threads, calls, file sharing and integrations, with PostgreSQL. The first account created becomes the system admin; set the site URL to the address people will use (behind Traefik: https://mattermost.<your domain>).

variables.name: MATTERMOST_SITE_URL
variables.label: Site URL
variables.description: The URL users open Mattermost at; links in e-mails and notifications use it

variables.name: MATTERMOST_DB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy
